what_it_does: HPC-R1 measures how efficiently Large Reasoning Models (advanced AI systems that spend more compute thinking before answering) train on HPC supercomputers. These models have multiple training stages: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) where the model learns from labeled examples, reinforcement learning from preference optimization (GRPO-based RL) where it improves via reward signals, text generation, and knowledge distillation to shrink the model. This paper profiles all stages on NERSC Perlmutter.
